entries.question: Cardiology appointment

*   **Emergency:** If this is a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**. For cardiology-specific emergencies, patients are typically stabilized at the Trauma Centre first and then transferred to the **LARI Cardiology** department.

entries.question: मुझे रिपोर्टर दिखाकर जानकारी चाहिए है क्या मिल सकती है

1. **मेडिकल सलाह:** मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा सलाह नहीं दे सकता। स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याओं के लिए कृपया KGMU ओपीडी में डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

3. **संपर्क:** यदि आपको किसी विशिष्ट विभाग या अधिकारी से संपर्क करना है, तो आप KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर देख सकते हैं या PRO कार्यालय से संपर्क कर सकते हैं: [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php)

आप क्या जानना चाहते हैं? कृपया अपना प्रश्न स्पष्ट रूप से पूछें।

entries.question: appointment lene ka process kya hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment lene ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon mein se kisi ek ka chunav kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Portal (ORS):**
*   Website [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   State (Uttar Pradesh) aur Hospital (KGMU) select karein.
*   'New Appointment' par click karke department, date aur time slot chunein.
*   Patient ka vivaran (details) bharein aur ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein.
*   Appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Aap **ABHA** ya **ORS** app ka upyog karke bhi isi prakriya (flow) se appointment book kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   8887019134 par "Appointment [Patient Name]" likhkar SMS bhejein aur booking confirmation prapt karein.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site):**
*   KGMU ke registration counter par jayein.
*   Patient ka **Aadhaar Number** aur **Active Mobile Number** saath rakhein.
*   Mobile par aaye OTP ko counter par dein, token prapt karein aur ₹50 ka bhugtan karke OPD slip lein.

**Mahatvapurn Jankari:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Parchi Counter:** registration counter 1:00 PM par band ho jata hai, isliye jaldi pahunchein.
*   **Bahari Shahar ke mareez:** Apne department ke liye valid referral letter zaroor saath layein.
*   **Pre-booking** ki salah di jati hai taaki wait time kam ho.

entries.question: Online opd registration cardiologist department lari kaise booking kare
entries.answer:
LARI Cardiology department ka appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Portal (ORS):**
*   Website par jayein: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   'New Appointment' par click karein.
*   State mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur Hospital mein 'King George's Medical University (KGMU)' chunein.
*   Department mein 'Cardiology' (LARI) select karein aur uplabdh date/time slot choose karein.
*   Patient ka vivaran (Aadhaar number aur mobile number) bharein aur ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein.
*   Appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Aap 'ABHA' ya 'ORS' app ka upyog karke bhi isi prakriya se appointment book kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   Apne registered mobile number se **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**4. Walk-in (On-site):**
*   Aap seedhe KGMU ke registration counter par bhi ja sakte hain.
*   **Zaroori:** Apne saath Aadhaar card aur active mobile number zaroor rakhein (OTP ke liye).
*   OPD ticket ki fees ₹50 hai.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   **Samay:** OPD registration counter subah 9:00 baje se 1:00 baje tak hi khule rehte hain.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath sambhandhit department ka valid referral zaroor layein.
*   **Sallah:** Bheed se bachne ke liye online pre-booking ki salah di jati hai.
